Iceland (Bing-dao 冰島) Iceland (Bing-dao 冰島) a kamu island han, u amisbayuan u cacay subal a kanatal, itini i Bei-daxiyang atu Beibingyang a lalikeluhan, Beiou u sakalima a kanatalan a cacay. Iceland (Bing-dao 冰島) kanatal a lala' u ahebal 10.3 a mang pen bang kungli, 36 a mangn ku tademaw, kanahatu caay ka ahebal ku hekal, Ouzhou a tademaw u ze'ket saadidi'ay nu kanatal, i kitakit u liwliw u ze'ket nu tademaw u saadidi'ay nu kanatal aca.
